STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURES
Enterprise Data Backup & Disaster Recovery SOP
RPO/RTO Targets, PostgreSQL WAL Archival, Daily Sandbox Verification, and Failover
Classification: Confidential
Version: 4.0
Owner: Infrastructure & Database Reliability
Review Cycle: Semi-Annual
1. Objective and Operational Metrics
This SOP defines the technical architecture, operational schedules, and disaster recovery procedures for enterprise data
systems at Apex Global Technologies. The procedure enforces strict compliance with our business continuity targets:
Recovery Point Objective (RPO): < 5 Minutes (achieved via continuous PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Log [WAL]
streaming to Amazon S3).
Recovery Time Objective (RTO): < 1 Hour (maximum tolerable time to restore primary database service from
backup).

3. Automated Recovery Verification and Sandbox Testing
Apex executes daily automated backup integrity verifications to ensure backups are not corrupted:
# Automated Daily Sandbox Restore Script (cron at 05:00 UTC)
1. Launch ephemeral PostgreSQL Docker container in test VPC
2. Download latest daily snapshot from s3://apex-backups-production/
3. Execute `pg_restore --clean --if-exists -d test_db latest_dump.sql`
4. Run validation queries: record counts, schema integrity, and sample query tests
5. Emit success metric to Datadog; alert Slack `#ops-backups` on any failure
6. Terminate ephemeral container
4. Disaster Recovery Failover Execution
In the event of a catastrophic regional AWS failure, the Incident Commander authorizes secondary region promotion:
# Promote Cross-Region Replica in us-west-2
aws rds promote-read-replica --db-instance-identifier apex-db-replica-west
# Update Route53 CNAME for database endpoint
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234 --change-batch file://failover.json
